arabic_html:
أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ
وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ
وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ ۞
translation: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? And yet, they threaten you with those they worship other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray, for him there is no guide.
explanation_html: The question answers itself. Ibn Kathīr: Allah is sufficient for the one who worships Him and relies on Him — when He is enough, no threat and no loss can truly reach you.
explanation_vo: The question answers itself. Ibn Kathir: Allah is sufficient for the one who worships Him and relies on Him — when He is enough, no threat and no loss can truly reach you.
